title: ev-hub-forecast-value: scoring EV charging-load forecasts by the operating cost of PV-storage-charging hubs
description: Code to build station-level charging load from the public UrbanEV and CHARGED datasets, train day-ahead forecasts, schedule and settle a PV-battery-grid hub at every station under day-ahead plan following and rolling re-optimisation, and compare forecast accuracy with operating regret. No data or results are included; the public datasets are downloaded from their original sources by scripts/download_data.sh.
